cardio.title: CARDIO
cardio.description: Improve your cardiovascular health and endurance with our diverse cardio program, featuring HIIT, steady-state cardio, and functional training.

professionalTrainer.title: PROFESSIONAL TRAINER
professionalTrainer.description: Our certified personal trainers create customized workout plans tailored to your specific goals, ensuring you maximize every session.

goodManagement.title: GOOD MANAGEMENT
goodManagement.description: Our dedicated staff ensures all equipment is well-maintained, facilities are clean, and your experience is seamless from check-in to check-out.

bmi.title: BMI Calculator
bmi.description: Body Mass Index (BMI) is a measure of body fat based on height and weight. It's a screening tool that can indicate whether you are underweight, normal weight, overweight, or obese.

tdee.title: TDEE Calculator
tdee.description: Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) estimates how many calories you burn per day. It accounts for your basal metabolic rate and physical activity level to determine your maintenance calories.

orm.title: 1RM Calculator
orm.description: One Repetition Maximum (1RM) estimates the maximum weight you can lift for a single repetition of an exercise. This helps track strength progress and determine appropriate training weights.
